title: leucanthemum vulgare subsp. subglaucum
intro: Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. subglaucum, commonly known as Oxeye Daisy, is a subspecies of the Oxeye Daisy plant, characterized by its greenish-gray leaves and white daisy-like flowers. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Oxeye Daisy include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and soothe digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
